Defined\nnow, before Phase 5 designs any UI — after that, taxonomies get retrofitted to screens.\n\n**Optical / acquisition** (the stall detector's job, `bf-5vm`):\n\n| Code | Meaning | User-facing |\n|---|---|---|\n| `E-NO-SIGNAL` | No decodable tiles at all | \"Point the camera at the sending screen.\" |\n| `E-TOO-FAR` | **camera** px/module < 4 (§2) | \"Move closer — the code is too small to read.\" |\n| `E-TOO-CLOSE` | Symbol exceeds frame, or below min focus | \"Move back a little.\" |\n| `E-BLUR` | Sharpness metric below threshold | \"Hold steady.\" |\n| `E-DARK` | Insufficient exposure | \"Too dark — raise the sender's screen brightness.\" |\n| `E-GLARE` | Saturated region over the code | \"Tilt to avoid the reflection.\" |\n| `E-FOCUS-HUNT` | Focus oscillating | \"Tap the screen to lock focus.\" |\n| `E-ORIENTATION` | Detected capture aspect doesn't match the sender's configured setting (§6.3.2) — e.g. sender is shaping the code for landscape but the receiver is held portrait | \"This app works fine held normally — but if you'd like more margin, match the orientation setting on the sending device, or turn the phone sideways.\" (tip, not a blocker — portrait is fully supported) |\n| `E-SENDER-STALLED` | Identical frames repeating | \"The sending device seems paused.\" |\n| `E-TORN` | Torn-frame rate high | \"Lower the sender's frame rate.\" |\n\n**Protocol:**\n\n| Code | Meaning | User-facing | Recovery |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `E-FOREIGN-STREAM` | Different `streamId` (E7) | \"That's a different file — ignoring it.\" | automatic, informational |\n| `E-VERSION` | Unknown `magic_ver` (§16.3) | \"The sending device is running version X; this one is Y. Update both.\" | user must update |\n| `E-META-BOUNDS` | Beacon field out of bounds (T1) | \"That transmission looks malformed and was rejected.\" | automatic, refuse |\n| `E-MANIFEST-CORRUPT` | Manifest CRC validation failed (§7.6) | \"The block manifest is corrupted and is being re-decoded.\" | automatic retry |\n| `E-MANIFEST-MISSING` | Manifest never arrived (§7.6) | \"Waiting for block manifest to verify received chunks.\" | wait or request repair |\n| `E-MANIFEST-DECODE` | Manifest fountain decode failed (§7.6) | \"Could not decode the block manifest. Retrying...\" | automatic retry |\n| `E-MANIFEST-LIVELOCK` | E12 livelock detected, manifest corrupted (bf-5fm) | \"Multiple chunks failed verification — the manifest appears corrupted. Re-decoding manifest...\" | re-decode manifest |\n| `E-BLOCK-HASH` | Rank K reached, hash failed (E12) | \"A chunk arrived corrupted and is being re-collected.\" | automatic retry |\n| `E-BLOCK-RETRY-EXCEEDED` | Block retry limit exceeded (E12 livelock, bf-5fm) | \"A chunk has failed verification too many times. Re-decoding manifest...\" | re-decode manifest |\n| `E-K-OVERFLOW` | Sender K exceeds receiver's maximum (D26) | \"Sender's chunk size is too large for this device. Use a smaller file or a more powerful receiver.\" | refuse, user adjusts |\n| `E-REPAIR-BOUNDS` | Repair code references blocks beyond file (§8.2) | \"That repair code refers to chunks that don't exist. Check it and try again.\" | user re-enters |\n| `E-REPAIR-CODE` | Repair code checksum failed | \"That repair code doesn't look right — check it and try again.\" | user re-enters |\n| `E-FILE-HASH` | Whole-file hash failed (E13) | \"The file is complete but failed its final check — saved as unverified.\" | keep output, warn |\n| `E-WASM-LOAD` | Decoder failed to load | \"The scanner failed to start. Reload the page.\" | user reloads |\n\n**Status codes** (informational, not errors):\n\n| Code | Meaning | User-facing |\n|---|---|---|\n| `E-VERIFYING` | Verifying blocks against manifest (§7.6) | \"Verifying received chunks against manifest...\" |\n\n**Local / resource:**\n\n| Code | Meaning | User-facing | Recovery |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `E-QUOTA-PREFLIGHT` | Not enough storage (§13.1) | \"Not enough free space: this needs X, you have Y.\" | user frees space |\n| `E-QUOTA-EXHAUSTED` | Ran out mid-transfer (E10) | \"Out of space. Saved what arrived — X of Y chunks.\" | partial export |\n| `E-SOURCE-CHANGED` | Source mutated (E5) | \"The file changed while sending. Start again to avoid a corrupt copy.\" | restart required |\n| `E-BACKGROUNDED` | Sender tab backgrounded (E8) | \"Sending paused — keep this tab visible.\" | auto-resume on focus |\n| `E-CAMERA-LOST` | Permission revoked (E9) | \"Camera access ended. This prevents network requests that would violate the G2 no-network assertion and enables offline operation.\n\n## Problem Statement\n\nPer plan.md §6.5, T5, T7, A8: The default zxing-wasm@1.2.11 behavior hard-codes a fastly.jsdelivr URL and fetches the .wasm lazily on first decode. This is unacceptable because:\n\n- **T7 Violation**: Makes third-party network requests mid-session (violating \"no telemetry\")\n- **A8 Violation**: Fails completely in airplane mode (air-gapped case)  \n- **T5 Violation**: Executes remotely-fetched WASM (security surface)\n\n## Solution\n\nUse `setZXingModuleOverrides({locateFile})` to point at a local WASM file instead of the CDN.\n\n## Implementation\n\n### Files Created/Modified\n\n1. **`/public/zxing_reader.wasm`** - Copy of WASM file from node_modules\n2. **`/src/modulation/qr-tiled/zxing-config.ts`** - Configuration module\n3. **`/spike/rig.js`** - Updated to import and use local configuration\n4. **`/test/network-assertion.test.ts`** - Updated to use local configuration\n\n### Configuration Module\n\nThe `zxxing-config.ts` module exports `configureLocalZXingWASM()` which:\n\n```typescript\nexport function configureLocalZXingWASM(): void {\n  setZXingModuleOverrides({\n    locateFile: (fileName: string) => {\n      if (fileName === 'zxing_reader.wasm') {\n        return '/zxing_reader.wasm'; // Serve from public directory\n      }\n      return fileName; // Default behavior for other files\n    },\n  });\n}\n```\n\n### Usage\n\nBefore any zxing-wasm operations, call:\n\n```typescript\nimport { configureLocalZXingWASM } from './zxxing-config';\n\nconfigureLocalZXingWASM(); // Must be called before any barcode operations\n```\n\n## Verification\n\n### Network Assertion Test\n\nThe G2 network assertion test (`test/network-assertion.test.ts`) now passes because:\n\n1. Local configuration is loaded before any zxing operations\n2. WASM is served from `/public/zxing_reader.wasm`\n3. No network requests are made during decode operations\n\n### Test Results\n\n```\n✓ test/network-assertion.test.ts  (12 tests) 31ms\nTest Files  1 passed (1)\n     Tests  12 passed (12)\n```\n\n### Manual Verification\n\nYou can verify the WASM file is being served locally by:\n\n1. Confirming `zxing_reader.wasm` is served from localhost (no external CDN requests)\n\n## Benefits\n\n### Security (T5)\n- WASM is served from known local source\n- No execution of remotely-fetched code\n- Deterministic WASM content\n\n### Privacy (T7)  \n- Zero network requests after app load\n- No telemetry or tracking\n- \"Provably no exfiltration\"\n\n### Reliability (A8)\n- Works in airplane mode\n- Works in air-gapped environments\n- No dependency on external CDN availability\n\n## Future Enhancements\n\n### Service Worker Integration\n\nFor true service worker precaching, add the WASM file to the service worker cache:\n\n```typescript\n// In service worker registration\nself.addEventListener('install', (event) => {\n  event.waitUntil(\n    caches.open('screenferry-v1').then((cache) => {\n      return cache.addAll([\n        '/zxing_reader.wasm',\n        // other assets...\n      ]);\n    })\n  );\n});\n```\n\n### Build Process Integration\n\nConsider adding a build step to automatically copy the WASM file:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"scripts\": {\n    \"postinstall\": \"cp node_modules/zxing-wasm/dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm public/\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## References\n\n- plan.md §6.5 - T5, T7, A8 requirements\n- plan.md §14.4 - G2 no-network assertion\n- concept.md constraint 1 - No telemetry\n- README.md - \"Provably no exfiltration\" guarantee\n\n## Testing\n\nRun the network assertion test to verify compliance:\n\n```bash\nnpm test -- test/network-assertion.test.ts\n```\n\nAll 12 tests should pass, confirming no network requests are made during zxing operations.","numLines":145,"startLine":1,"totalLines":145}}}
